## 学校共用申请资料

以下是已核实的学校规则，适用资格与年度在各条中说明；具体专业还可能要求先修科目、考试、作品集或另行申请。

### 专业说明

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：目录与学位范围：</strong>本批覆盖索邦大学文学、科学工程、健康学院已采集的学位与路径；专业Licence、主辅修、双Licence、内部L2/L3和健康第一周期有不同入口，不将每条都称为高中直申三年学位。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-letters-international">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-sorbonne-programme-128">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-sorbonne-programme-153">官方依据</a></p>

### 入学条件

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：大陆高中资格：</strong>中国居住且持外国高中学历、非欧盟公民申请普通L1，使用DAP并经本国Campus France/Études en France；法国或欧洲高中资格、已在法国高等教育就读等类别程序不同。本轮未取得可全校通用的高考分数线。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-letters-international">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-sorbonne-science-foreign-l1">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：法语证明：</strong>文学本科和科学工程本科最低要求法语B2，须提供认可证明；文学学院明确外国法语/文学学历本身也不自动免测。具体外语、音乐或跨学科项目另有先修与选拔。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-letters-international">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-sorbonne-science-foreign-l1">官方依据</a></p>

### 申请安排

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：2027时间缺口：</strong>2027完整大陆申请窗口本轮未取得。科学英文L1页虽更新于2026仍含2024日程，外国学历页又混有2024/25与2026日期；这些旧日期不能作为2027截止。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-science-l1">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-sorbonne-science-foreign-l1">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：高年级申请：</strong>文学L2/L3：居住Études en France国家者经相应平台，其他境外地区或法国居住者按e-candidat；申请高年级仍须审查先前学业。联合、学徒、健康和特定学校路线以本项规则为准。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-letters-international">官方依据</a></p>

### 学费与资助

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：2026/27费用与减免：</strong>2026/27国家Licence注册费EUR178，但中国等非欧盟新生应先判断差别收费及豁免。校方2026-07-07政策可对提出申请且符合所定标准者减免至普通标准；这不是无需申请的保证，2027/28政策本轮未取得。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-fees">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-sorbonne-exemption">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：申请减免：</strong>学校按个人资源、健康、家庭距离/断裂或残障等情况评估，通过学生资助平台的差别收费减免活动提交；CVEC另外办理。合作院校、学徒、继续教育和健康专门资格的总账不能仅用EUR178估算。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-fees">官方依据</a></p>

### 毕业生情况

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>同校共用：职业方向与统计：</strong>本轮课程说明可支持所列升学、研究或行业方向；没有将这些描述转为本科就业率或薪资。专业独立、届次明确且适用中国学生的调查本轮未核实。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-sorbonne-programme-17">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-sorbonne-programme-113">官方依据</a></p>

## 专业目录覆盖记录

**官方目录仍在补齐**，共 159 项；这不是全字段详情的完成状态。

<p><strong>统计范围：</strong>Lettres full bachelor-level catalogue cards, Science eight mentions and named double/intensive/apprenticeship/professional routes, health first-cycle/grade-licence programmes.</p>

<p><strong>对账方法：</strong>Lettres all22 pages of public search service fetched;214 unique cards exactly reconcile all diploma facets. Included37 Licence+30 Double licence+8 LAS+8 Majeure/mineure+3 LP+3 undergraduate double diploma=89. Science full licence tree and8 disciplinary pages read;16 science-science doubles,7 professional licences and all named intensive/apprenticeship indexes read. Health overview and all listed paramedical/university-affiliated branch pages read.</p>

<p><strong>排除项：</strong>Exclude Masters, graduate concours preparations, generic DU, standalone minors, individual units. L1–L3 ordinary year pages stored as curriculum_stages under their programme. Merge5 science/humanities joint programme duplicates with Lettres identities. Explicitly identify first-cycle stages; not all entries are independent bachelor awards. Original French titles kept.</p>

**尚未解决的目录缺口：**

- Lettres programme-card inventory is complete; all embedded subtracks under L3 year pages have not yet been separately normalized as programme identities.
- Science eight mentions and explicit indexed routes are covered, but full reconciliation of every intra-major option, all joint-curriculum branches and CMI bachelor-bearing pathways is incomplete. Do not claim whole-university completeness.
- Psychomotricité and Kinésithérapie were read but not assigned a bachelor/grade-licence award without clearer collected evidence. Complete medical/paramedical institutional and cohort-specific award perimeter remains to be reconciled.
- Maïeutique source distinguishes new six-year reform and legacy first-cycle structure. Orthophonie is explicitly a first-cycle stage, with final master-level qualification.
